env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# Ordinary generics call a later private generic with a standalone const
# switch. The calls come through a const for, directly, and through an
# exported wrapper in another package. The imported call distinguishes an
# alias from a defined type with the same underlying type. Native and
# ejected builds must print the same results.

cd m
logos run .
stdout '^forwarded 2$'
stdout '^direct 2 1$'
stdout '^plain 2$'
stdout '^imported exact underlying$'
cp stdout expected.txt
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
exists out/version/version.go
cd out
go run .
stdout '^forwarded 2$'
stdout '^direct 2 1$'
stdout '^plain 2$'
stdout '^imported exact underlying$'
cmp stdout ../expected.txt
exists $UPROOT1274/bin/go
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1274/bin/go run .
stdout '^forwarded 2$'
stdout '^direct 2 1$'
stdout '^plain 2$'
stdout '^imported exact underlying$'
cmp stdout ../expected.txt
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/ctforwarded

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"comptime"
	"fmt"

	"example.com/ctforwarded/version"
)

type Row struct {
	ID  int64
	Ver int32
}

type Table struct {
	ver int
}

type ExactVersion = int64
type NamedVersion int64

func mapCol[E any, K comparable, F any](t *Table, name string, project func(*E) *F) {
	if name == "Ver" {
		t.ver = versionCol[E, F](project)
	}
}

func versionCol[E any, F any](project func(*E) *F) int {
	const switch F {
	case int64:
		return 1
	case int32:
		return 2
	}
	return 0
}

func mapTable[E any, K comparable](t *Table) {
	const if comptime.IsStruct[E]() {
		const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[E]() {
			mapCol[E, K, f.Type](t, f.Name, func(e *E) *f.Type { return &e.[f] })
		}
	}
}

func probeCol[E any, K comparable, F any](t *Table, project func(*E) *F) {
	t.ver = versionCol[E, F](project)
}

func main() {
	table := &Table{}
	mapTable[Row, int64](table)
	fmt.Println("forwarded", table.ver)

	d32 := &Table{}
	probeCol[Row, int64, int32](d32, func(e *Row) *int32 { return &e.Ver })
	d64 := &Table{}
	probeCol[Row, int64, int64](d64, func(e *Row) *int64 { return &e.ID })
	fmt.Println("direct", d32.ver, d64.ver)

	plain := versionCol[Row, int32](func(e *Row) *int32 { return &e.Ver })
	fmt.Println("plain", plain)

	fmt.Println("imported", version.Kind[ExactVersion](), version.Kind[NamedVersion]())
}

-- m/version/version.lgo --
package version

func Kind[T any]() string {
	return kindOf[T]()
}

func kindOf[T any]() string {
	const switch T {
	case int64:
		return "exact"
	case ~int64:
		return "underlying"
	}
	return "other"
}
